report: 图像中存在明显的块状结构和DCT系数分布异常，可能表明经过了JPEG压缩。然而，单独的JPEG压缩痕迹并不能确定图像的真实性，因为重压缩后的图像上该证据近乎无效，不得作为独立判据。尽管如此，我们已经获得了足够的信息来评估图像的真实性。但由于现有的工具无法提供更具体的鉴别信息，且这些工具的结果存在一定的不确定性，我们无法进一步降低图像真实性的不确定性。因此，基于现有证据，我们得出以下结论：图像的真实性存在不确定性。

evidence.phenomenon: JPEG structural analysis reveals DCT coefficient histogram hollowing. (blockiness: 1.3759, DCT anomaly: 3.3541)
evidence.reasoning: Moderate JPEG structure found (blockiness=1.3759, DCT anomaly=3.3541). This is the weaker end of the calibration band: the same structure appears when an already-compressed image is re-saved, and at low quality (≤ 70) the band loses its discriminative power almost entirely, so it should not drive a verdict on its own. Whether the band is decisive here depends on the cell the calibration table records for this input, which is attached to the token.
evidence.interpretation_text: Calibration: this measurement band is near chance (P(Fake)=0.45) and does not determine a direction.
evidence.counter_explanation: 本指标衡量"是否存在 JPEG 压缩历史"而非伪造痕迹：G2 校准显示高值倾向 Real（PNG 格分离度 0.972、native 0.962，但重压缩至 q70 后降至 0.569），即它主要反映来源的压缩历史。统一重压缩后的图像上该证据近乎无效，不得作为独立判据。
evidence.applicability_conditions: 高 strength 统计上对应 Real（原生 JPEG 照片）；q70 配平后分离度仅 0.57。仅当来源无压缩历史时可反向参考。
evidence.interpretation_text_raw: Intermediate JPEG structural level; this band is near the calibrated chance level, and re-compression weakens it further.
